<!doctype html>
<html lang="vi"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="color-scheme" content="light"><title>PKT SG10 | Họp tháng 10.2026 — Presentation Dashboard</title>
<style>
:root{--navy:#103461;--navy2:#183E73;--royal:#1659B9;--sky:#0E88CB;--orange:#F37021;--green:#00A859;--red:#D74458;--amber:#D98E17;--text:#173354;--muted:#637C96;--line:#D5E5F0;--light:#F4F9FE;--white:#fff;--font:"Segoe UI", "Arial", sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.68,.18,1)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;font-family:var(--font);color:var(--text);background:#dceefa}button,input,select{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fc8c40;outline-offset:3px}button{user-select:none} .app{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 60% 20%,#e1f4ff,#f1f6fe 70%)}
#stage{width:1600px;height:900px;position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(var(--stage-scale,1));transform-origin:center;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 55px #3c638047;isolation:isolate}
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#fbfdff,#edf7fe)}.scene.active{display:block}.scene:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background-image:radial-gradient(#4a8ed912 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:29px 29px;opacity:.33}
.scene .photo{position:absolute;z-index:0;right:-10px;top:0;height:100%;width:64%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;filter:saturate(1.17) brightness(1.11);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,#000 30%);opacity:.92;pointer-events:none}.scene .photo.soft{opacity:.22;filter:brightness(1.40) saturate(.7)}.scene .photo.slim{width:42%;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 25%)}.scene .photo.half{width:50%}.scene .photo.bottom{top:39%;height:61%;mask-image:linear-gradient(0deg,#000 0%,transparent 99%);width:100%;opacity:.16}
.hero-glow{position:absolute;right:-300px;top:-320px;width:850px;height:850px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#87d6ff45,transparent 69%);pointer-events:none}.warm-glow{background:radial-gradient(circle,#ffcfa16b,transparent 70%)}
.topbar{position:absolute;left:62px;right:64px;top:38px;height:56px;z-index:10;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;color:var(--navy);font-size:18px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.4px}.mark{width:68px;height:34px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2px;transform:skew(-10deg)}.mark b{display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:24px;line-height:1;color:white;border-radius:3px}.mark b:nth-child(1){background:#126AC0}.mark b:nth-child(2){background:#F37021}.mark b:nth-child(3){background:#19AE57}.brand-join{height:24px;width:2px;background:#CADDEB;margin:0 10px}.eyebrow{font-size:13px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--royal)}.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:#E5F2FF;border:1px solid #CCE4F8;border-radius:8px;color:var(--royal);padding:9px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.5px}
#stepNo{background:#0d5ec4;color:white;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:900;font-size:13px;min-width:85px;text-align:center}
.slide-title{font-weight:900;font-size:59px;line-height:1.07;letter-spacing:-2px;color:var(--navy);margin:0}.slide-title span{color:var(--orange)}.headline{font-size:26px;font-weight:830;margin:0;color:var(--navy)}.sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.5}
.footer{position:absolute;z-index:10;left:62px;right:64px;bottom:24px;height:29px;border-top:1px solid #C7DDEB;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;color:#617E9C;font-size:12px}.footer b{color:var(--navy)}.footer .mini-tag{opacity:.65}
.page-indicators{position:absolute;bottom:31px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:7px}.page-indicators button{width:24px;height:5px;border-radius:8px;background:#C8DEEF;border:none;padding:0;transition:.3s}.page-indicators button.active{width:50px;background:var(--orange)}
#slidePrev,#slideNext{position:fixed;z-index:42;bottom:21px;border:1px solid #C3DDEA;background:#fff;color:#1457A4;border-radius:50%;height:43px;width:43px;font-size:22px;box-shadow:0 7px 20px #2349681b;transition:.25s}#slidePrev:hover,#slideNext:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);background:#eaf5ff}#slidePrev{left:25px}#slideNext{right:25px}
#menuBtn{position:fixed;top:16px;right:18px;z-index:42;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d5e7f6;border-radius:12px;color:#1952a0;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;padding:10px 14px;box-shadow:0 4px 15px #14375b20}
.card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);border:1px solid #D9E9F4;border-radius:19px;box-shadow:0 13px 33px rgba(44,105,154,.09);position:relative}.card.shadow{box-shadow:0 17px 48px rgba(30,75,138,.15)}
.interact{position:relative;text-align:left;border:1px solid #cddfeb;background:#fff;transition:transform .24s var(--ease), box-shadow .24s var(--ease),border-color .24s var(--ease);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}.interact:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:#65b2e9;box-shadow:0 16px 30px #2d77bd2a}.interact:active{transform:translateY(-1px) scale(.995)}.interact:after{content:'↗ XEM CHI TIẾT';position:absolute;right:15px;top:14px;color:var(--royal);font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.1em;opacity:.72}.interact:hover:after{color:var(--orange);opacity:1}.interact .shine{pointer-events:none;position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(320px circle at var(--mx,-100px) var(--my,-100px),rgba(27,161,241,.10),transparent 48%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}.interact:hover .shine{opacity:1}.tap{display:inline-flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#EAF4FF;color:#1460AE;border:1px solid #C8E5F8;padding:9px 13px;font-weight:850;font-size:12px;border-radius:999px}.tap::before{content:'↗';font-size:15px;color:var(--orange)}
.kpi{padding:23px 25px}.kpi .klabel{font-size:14px;font-weight:850;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.2px}.kpi .knumber{margin:10px 0 4px;display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:45px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-1.6px;font-weight:900}.kpi .knote{color:#648199;font-size:13px}.kpi .knumber.orange{color:var(--orange)}.kpi .knumber.blue{color:var(--royal)}.kpi .knumber.green{color:var(--green)}.kpi .knumber.red{color:var(--red)}
.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .micro{font-size:12px;color:#6e879c}.bluebar{background:#DDECF7;border-radius:99px;height:12px;overflow:hidden}.bluebar .fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0E79CC,#19B5EB);height:100%;width:0;border-radius:99px;transition:width 1.2s var(--ease)}.orangebar .fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#F37320,#FFAE55)}.greenbar .fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0CA85B,#5BDEA4)}
.status-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;background:#36a4ff;margin-right:7px}.status-dot.red{background:#e95668}.status-dot.green{background:#19b977}.status-dot.orange{background:#f5a63e}
.ring{width:210px;height:210px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;flex:0 0 auto}.ring:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:15px;background:white;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #e5edf5}.ring>div{position:relative;text-align:center}.ring b{display:block;font-size:45px;line-height:1;color:var(--navy);font-weight:900}.ring span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#667b91;margin-top:4px}
/* slide 1 */
.scene-cover{background:linear-gradient(95deg,#fff 0%,#fff 44%,#e4f5ff 100%)}.cover-copy{position:absolute;left:84px;top:189px;width:900px}.cover-copy .slide-title{font-size:71px;line-height:1.1;margin-top:25px}.cover-copy .lead{font-size:21px;color:#395f84;margin:26px 0 0;font-weight:600}.cover-bullets{position:absolute;left:84px;bottom:157px;display:flex;gap:20px}.focus{width:400px;padding:19px 22px;min-height:106px;border-radius:17px;border:1px solid #d3e7f6;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);box-shadow:0 8px 20px #3974ad20}.focus i{display:inline-flex;width:32px;height:32px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:10px;background:#fff0e5;color:#ec7224;font-size:17px;font-style:normal;font-weight:900;margin-right:9px}.focus b{font-size:19px;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.34}.cover-meta{position:absolute;right:94px;bottom:174px;padding:13px 20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);border:1px solid #ffffffbb;border-radius:13px;box-shadow:0 12px 34px #1b4e9a2b;font-size:14px;font-weight:850;color:var(--navy)}
/* slide 2 */
.scene-sales{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#FAFDFF,#EDF6FE)}.sales-head{position:absolute;top:132px;left:76px;right:72px}.sales-layout{position:absolute;left:76px;right:72px;top:253px;bottom:90px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:590px 1fr;gap:21px}.sales-left{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:15px}.sales-progress{height:265px;padding:28px 30px}.sales-progress .giant{font-size:76px;color:var(--orange);font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-4px;line-height:1}.sales-progress .big-sub{font-size:17px;font-weight:850;margin:11px 0 18px;color:var(--navy)}.sales-mini{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:15px;flex:1}.sales-mini .kpi{padding:21px}.sales-mini .knumber{font-size:54px}.team-panel{padding:21px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.team-panel-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:9px}.teambar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:182px 1fr 89px;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:13px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #E8F0F6;cursor:pointer;border-radius:10px;transition:.22s}.teambar:hover{background:#EAF5FF}.teambar b{font-size:17px}.teambar .pct{color:var(--navy);font-size:19px;font-weight:900;text-align:right}.teambar .count{font-size:11px;color:#68829c;text-align:right}.teambar .bluebar{height:13px}

.scene-staff{background:linear-gradient(115deg,#F9FDFF,#E8F5FF)}.staff-head{position:absolute;left:76px;top:118px;right:65px}.staff-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:20px}.staff-layout{position:absolute;left:76px;top:380px;right:76px;bottom:90px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:23px}.staff-team{padding:22px 24px}.staff-team table{margin-top:9px}.staff-team th,.staff-team td{text-align:left;font-size:16px;padding:13px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #E6F0F7}.staff-team th{font-size:12px;color:#67819A;letter-spacing:.3px}.staff-team tbody tr{cursor:pointer}.staff-team tbody tr:hover{background:#EDF7FE}.staff-team td strong{color:var(--navy)}.staff-aside{padding:27px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(9,91,178,.95),rgba(11,54,114,.97));color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}.staff-aside .aside-head{font-size:27px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.26}.staff-aside .aside-line{padding:15px 0;border-top:1px solid #ffffff3a;font-size:17px;line-height:1.55}.staff-aside .aside-button{width:100%;background:#fff;color:#0c56a2;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;font-weight:900;font-size:16px}
/* slide 4 */
.scene-kickoff{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#fff9f3,#fff 55%,#ebf6ff)}.campaign-layout{position:absolute;top:140px;left:76px;right:72px;bottom:92px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:665px 1fr;gap:24px}.campaign-lead{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}.campaign-main{padding:27px 30px;min-height:230px}.campaign-main .giant{font-size:79px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-3px;line-height:1.01;color:var(--orange)}.campaign-main .sub{font-weight:780;color:#355b7c;margin-top:6px}.campaign-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}.campaign-metrics .kpi{padding:17px}.campaign-metrics .knumber{font-size:39px}.campaign-graphic{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}.poster-preview{padding:19px 20px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:365px}.poster-shelf{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:14px;justify-content:center;align-items:stretch;height:275px}.poster-shelf button{border:2px solid #E0EDF5;border-radius:12px;padding:6px;background:white;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #1b467d1c;flex:1;min-width:0;transition:.25s}.poster-shelf button:hover{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-1deg);border-color:var(--orange)}.poster-shelf img{height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:contain}.campaign-choices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;height:130px}.campaign-choices button{padding:16px 20px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe5ef;border-radius:16px;font-size:16px;font-weight:850;color:var(--navy)}.campaign-choices button b{display:block;color:var(--orange);font-size:23px;margin-top:8px}
/* slide 5 */
.scene-csat{background:linear-gradient(132deg,#FBFDFF,#EAF8FC)}.csat-layout{position:absolute;top:143px;left:76px;right:72px;bottom:91px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:620px 1fr;gap:22px}.csat-left{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:19px}.csat-primary{padding:30px 35px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:27px;height:310px}.csat-primary h2{font-size:27px;color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 10px}.csat-primary .csat-alert{font-size:19px;color:var(--red);font-weight:900}.csat-mini{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:17px;flex:1}.csat-mini .kpi .knumber{font-size:40px}.csat-team{padding:21px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.csat-legend{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}.csat-team-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 77px;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:20px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #E6EFF7;cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;transition:.18s}.csat-team-row:hover{background:#edf6fd}.csat-team-row .rlabel{font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);font-size:15px}.csat-team-row .rval{font-weight:900;color:var(--red);font-size:18px;text-align:right}.csat-team-row .rval.ok{color:var(--green)}
/* slide 6 */
.scene-alerts{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#fff,#FFF8F8 49%,#F0F8FF)}.alerts-head{position:absolute;left:76px;top:127px;right:72px}.alerts-layout{position:absolute;left:76px;top:291px;right:72px;bottom:92px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:19px}.alert-box{padding:24px 28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}.alert-box .bigalert{font-size:65px;font-weight:950;color:var(--red);line-height:1}.alert-box h3{margin:8px 0 3px;font-size:24px;color:var(--navy)}.alert-box p{font-size:17px;color:#617d96;line-height:1.47}.alert-mini-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.alert-mini-list .person{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px dashed #d7e6ef;padding:9px 0;font-size:16px}.alert-mini-list b{color:var(--navy)}.alert-mini-list em{color:var(--red);font-style:normal;font-weight:900}
/* slide 7 */
.scene-close{background:linear-gradient(115deg,#FCFFFF,#F0F9FF)}.close-head{position:absolute;left:82px;top:175px;width:1000px}.close-head .slide-title{font-size:58px}.close-steps{position:absolute;left:82px;top:375px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,460px);gap:14px}.close-step{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe9f4;border-left:5px solid #1778C0;box-shadow:0 10px 26px #2a63961b;border-radius:12px;padding:21px 22px;min-height:130px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}.close-step strong{font-size:24px;color:var(--orange);align-self:flex-start}.close-step h3{font-size:19px;margin:0 0 5px;color:var(--navy)}.close-step p{font-size:15px;margin:0;line-height:1.42;color:#627d95}.close-message{position:absolute;left:82px;bottom:125px;font-weight:900;font-size:19px;color:#166ab1}

@media(max-width:700px){#modalback{padding:8px}.modal{width:100vw;max-height:96vh}.modal-top{padding:14px 15px}.modal-top h2{font-size:19px}.modal-body{padding:12px}.modal-toolbar input{min-width:100%;width:100%}.data-table td,.data-table th{padding:10px;font-size:12px}.poster-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

.csat-team-row .bluebar{position:relative;overflow:visible;background:#e9edf5}
.csat-team-row .bluebar::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:-3px;bottom:-3px;left:18.75%;width:2px;background:#f2992e;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff8;border-radius:2px;z-index:2}
.csat-team-row .bluebar .fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#F48E6D,#DC4565)}
.csat-team-row:has(.rval.ok) .bluebar .fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1ba974,#52d4a0)}

.scene.active .bluebar .fill{transform-origin:left center;animation:fillIn .72s cubic-bezier(.18,.74,.26,1) both}
@keyframes fillIn{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
